Greco-Roman marble temple complex, Corinthian capitals trailing sea-anemone clusters, standing improbably upright on a silt-covered plaza.
Egyptian pylon temple, hieroglyph-carved sandstone faces etched with cartouche bands, tilted forward into a deep coral shelf.
Mayan step-pyramid, jaguar-glyph reliefs climbing each terrace face, upper platform breached and colonized by branching staghorn coral.
Khmer face-tower, four serene sandstone visages gazing outward, leaning eastward into a sedimented lotus-pond basin.
Babylonian ziggurat, seven glazed-brick tiers ascending through blue haze, lapiswork lion friezes still intact on the lowest level.
Polynesian moai colossi, basalt heads face-down in a long ceremonial row, drifting sand slowly swallowing their carved topknots.
Phoenician harbor platform, basalt anchor-bay stones arranged in their original crescent arc, encrusted with white barnacle ridges.
Minoan megaron palace wing, red-painted bull-fresco panels still vivid above a fallen row of slender tapered columns.
Indus Valley stepped tank, geometric fired-brick courses descending in precise terraces, a columned hall collapsed along the southern edge.
Japanese pagoda foundation platform, carved lotus-petal base stones intact, the tiered granite socle standing upright in soft seafloor silt.
Greco-Roman amphitheater, marble tiered seating spiraling into a coral-grown bowl, proscenium stage split along a diagonal fracture.
Egyptian sphinx avenue, twelve sandstone lion-bodied forms still aligned, ceremonial headdress nemes-cloth carved in crisp relief.
Aztec temple pyramid, double staircase adorned with feathered-serpent balustrades, the upper shrine chamber open to the surrounding current.
Assyrian palace gateway, paired lamassu colossi with human-bearded faces and cuneiform-inscribed plinths, standing upright beside a fallen lintel.
Easter Island basalt ahu platform, rectangular stone coursework intact, three toppled moai resting on their backs across the ceremonial terrace.
Carthaginian harbor seawall, dressed basalt blocks laid in herringbone bond, ancient iron-ring anchor stones still set in their sockets.
Minoan pillar crypt, square ashlar columns carrying double-axe labrys carvings, the entire crypt sunken but structurally coherent.
Khmer gopuram tower, kalasha finial still crowning the sandstone spire, devata relief figures readable along every vertical pilaster.
Norte Chico stone columned hall, granite monoliths arranged in two parallel rows, geometric incised bands encircling each column at mid-height.
Olmec colossal head, basalt helmet-carved monolith face-up on the seafloor, broad ceremonial features half-occluded by encrusting pink coralline algae.
Roman aqueduct, ashlar-cut arches spanning a seafloor canyon in a long receding line, caustic light shafting through each broken arch.
Egyptian granite colonnade, pink Aswan granite shafts carved with papyrus-bundle capitals, the row leaning uniformly into a southward current tilt.
Toltec Atlantean colonnade, warrior-figure stone pillars standing in two parallel ranks, feathered-headdress faces coral-eaten above the shoulder line.
Babylonian Ishtar-gate fragment, cobalt-glazed brick panels bearing striding aurochs in procession relief, wedged face-first into a silt embankment.
Hindu lingam complex, a granite Shiva lingam on its yoni pedestal upright at center, surrounding shrine walls draped in cascading kelp fronds.
